en: My special skill is... my presentation!

Thinking about my personal brand,
and then executing on it.

I'd say it was only because I did that well that
I succeeded in an industry as tough as this.

I see. If that's the case,
you must have...
...Good use of social media and blogs, right?

Yeah! Wow!
You're into that kinda stuff too, Kiryu-san?
I'm decent for my age.

If ya can advertise effectively on social media
or a blog, new customers request you more often.

So Kiryu-san, if ya ever decide to become a host,
you should give it a shot.
I'll keep that in mind.

...Fliers or something, right? Or maybe putting
yourself on some pocket tissues would work.

Kiryu-san, that's a little old-fashioned... It
might've worked a decade ago, but not any more.

I used social media and my blog to advertise.
It's been really effective.

...Blasted emails to a whole bunch of random
people? Chain letters and stuff like that.

I would never be so inconsiderate!
I'm not some kinda con-artist.

Oh yeah, the other day,
a customer from Kyoto came in.

All the way here?
That's dedication.
Not only that, it was a girl.
A girl? At a cabaret club?

Yeah. She said she came all the way
to Kamurocho just to see me.
Was she a fan of yours?

I guess so. She said she was a regular reader
on my blog. Melted my heart.

Yeah, I guess girls read blogs, too...
Times sure are changing...

Actually, about 30% of the people who
request me are women.

That's really something.
You've got a wide appeal.

Oh, stop. But, it is refreshing to
be admired by your own gender.
Was she a friend?
No, she was a fan who followed my blog.
Was she your girlfriend? Wait, are you...
No! She was a fan who followed my blog.

Hmm... I don't know if I'd say it's a lot,
but I guess I have my fair share of girl friends.

But if I had to come out and say it,
I think women like me more than men.

I even get some women who
come in here as customers.
Kiryu-san, what kind of friends do you have?

I try not to talk about it too openly, but...
I know a lot of people in the yakuza.

Oh really...
Well, I guess that does fit your image.
...Is that the kind of image I have?
Cute women... I guess.
You do seem good with the ladies, Kiryu-san.

Not really. But, I'd say there's a pretty
good lady right here in front of me.

Oh, Kiryu-san. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Flattery'll get you nowhere with me.
Some taxi drivers, I guess.
Huh? Did you used to be a driver?

A few years back. They took me in when I had no
where to go. I owe my boss and coworkers a lot.

Wow. Just goes to show ya never know a person's
history. I'm glad ya have friends like that.

I don't play too many games, but I dabble
with them on my phone sometimes.

Do you play games, Kiryu-san?
You don't seem like the type.

I play a lot, actually.
I hit the arcades sometimes.

Wow! You're a game master!
You should tell me more about that sometime.

I don't play them much anymore.
I did when I was younger, though.

I see. Sounds like you'll have to study up
on some modern games.
Life is its own sort of game.
Ooh. That's really deep.
Ooh. That's pretty deep.

True, at your age, I bet you've got
a lot of experience under your belt.
I wanna hear all about your life, Kiryu-san. <symbol=note_with_outline>
It's not as interesting as you'd think.
Huh? What kind of secret?
Ages ago... I was the chairman.

You mean like, student council president?
You're just serious enough to do that.
I was actually raised in an orphanage.
I wouldn't'a guessed...

I lost both my parents. But my guardian and the
other orphans became like a family to me.

I was raised by a single mother,
so I understand how that feels.

I'm sure I caused her no end of headaches, but...
That's why I'm workin' so hard to pay her back.
I'm glad we got to talk about this together.

...No, I probably shouldn't. 
I shouldn't just go around sharing my secrets.

Really!? Come on, tell me!
Ya got me curious!

It seems like a lot of people
get them for fashion nowadays.
Fashion... Is that all they are these days?
How you do feel about that, Kiryu-san?

As long as it's all in good fun,
I don't have any complaints.

Oh, really? I woulda thought
you'd say it was shameful.

I don't think that would be
very convincing coming from me.

I'm not sure I approve of people
getting them just for fashion's sake.

It's engraved into your skin, so you need
to be prepared to live with it forever.

I see... That's thoughtful.
You can't erase it, after all.

Yeah. When I got mine,
I understood the consequences.

I see... Wait, what!?
You have one, Kiryu-san?
Why didn't ya say so sooner?
Sorry, sorry.

I can't hold mine very well.
It makes this job hard sometimes.

Help me understand what's so great about drinking.
What do you see in it, Kiryu-san?

I like how it makes me feel.
It also helps me forget the bad stuff.
You have bad memories too, huh, Kiryu-san?

Well, yeah. I'd bet most of the guys who come in
to drink do. So why not help them out? Goes for me, too.

You're right. Even though I can't drink,
I'll try to enjoy it in my own way.

It's good for your health.
They say it makes you live longer.

Huh? Really?
I thought it was generally considered unhealthy.

Apparently the issue is how much you drink.
Some people say it's good for beauty, too.

Wow, really? If it's good for beauty,
maybe I should give it another chance!

It's proof you're a man. Only real
men can hold their alcohol.
I see... And what if you're a woman?
Huh? Um... No idea.

I've heard about them on the news. All I
got from it is how scary they are, though.

I know her. Idol fans still talk
about her debut concert to this day.
Oh? What have you done?

I've been in a movie before.
Just as a stand-in, though.

Wow! Doesn't matter what, that's awesome!
What kinda movie?

An action movie.
It was just a small thing.
I used to fight in an arena a lot.
What? You're a martial artist, Kiryu-san?

Martial arts isn't quite right, but...
Well, something like that.

When I was in Fukuoka,
I had a showdown with a street racer.

A street racer...?
Like a biker gang or something?

It's a little different, but we raced
for the title of fastest in Fukuoka.

Hmm. I'd be worried about
getting into an accident.

I don't really cook.
Sometimes I make some snacks, though.

I'm a typical type A. Temperamental and serious,
I guess. People ask me if I'm type A a lot.
That's a bit much, isn't it?
I'll leave that to your imagination.
...I wonder.

There's someone I'm interested in...
I guess?

I wasn't going to pursue this line of work,
but a friend invited me to try it out.

Now I've been at it for quite some time.
Strange how life works sometimes, huh?
What's gotten into you?
Hey, that's not how the game works...

Yaaaay! Wait, that's not how the game works.
C'mon now.

Lemme think... I guess I listen to Western
music every now and again.
I'm glad to hear you say that.
It's fun spending time with you, too. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Hasn't it?
I'm doing my best to avoid gettin' sick.

That's nice to hear, even if you are just
flattering me. Just don't get sick, huh?

Oh, Kiryu-san...
You're makin' me blush.
Whoa!? What's gotten into you?
Uh... Forget that just happened.

Whoa! That scared me!
Is that what you're really like?
No... It's just fun to do that.

A little out of character... 
but as long as you're havin' fun, I'm happy. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Whoa! What's gotten into you?

Hey, you started it, Kiryu-san!
I'm havin' fun too, so I gave it a shot.

That felt better than I thought it would.
Maybe I should start shouting more.
Hello, Kiryu-san.

Hey, you can't do that!
Geez, you're hopeless.

Thanks.
A compliment always makes my day.
Huh? Really!?

Yeah. It's a beautiful establishment,
always clean down to the corners.

Whaaaat!? That's what you meant?
You're terrible!
Just kidding.
Kiryu-san? Are you okay?
Uh... Never mind.

Oh Kiryu-san, you're so greedy. If I agree,
does that mean you'll only have eyes for me?

Not at the moment.
I've got my eyes peeled, though.
There may be someone I'm interested in...
I do... Maybe they don't realize it yet...
Then, I'll be careful not to fall for you! <symbol=note_with_outline>
It... might be too late.

Thanks. We try to make sure our
customers can relax while they're here.
We want them all to walk away satisfied.

You guys have your head in the game.
No wonder it feels so good to be here.

I'm pretty new in Tokyo, so I don't have the lay
of the land yet. I do want to try places, though.
I... I don't really know what to say...

What what what!? You really went that wild?
You'll leave the club alone, though, right?

You poor guy...
I'll listen if you ever want to let it out.

Kiryu-san, I can tell he was
really important to you...

A true friend...
That's a pretty tough question.
Yeah. I don't have much of an answer myself.

You're the kinda guy who values his friends,
Kiryu-san. That's what I like about you.

I wasn't expectin' that!
You can't judge a book by its cover!

That's amazing! I have so much respect for
people who can do things I can't.

Kiryu-san fishing...
I'd like to see that sometime.

If you visit me in Onomichi,
I'll show you the whole process.

That sounds rough...
Be careful out there, okay?

Maybe you have some kind of charismatic
aura that draws angry people to you?

You do have a different aura than most people.
Yep! It's your charisma!
I wish I didn't...

Wow, I've never heard of that before.
Who knew? It does sound fun, though.
Wow, really? For your health?

Well, something like that.
I also just want to keep getting stronger.

You want to improve yourself, huh?
I love people like that.

I've been thinking about joinin' a gym myself.
You'll have to tell me more about that.
Does that mean you don't like clubs like this?

No... I like this club because it
means I get to see you.
Kiryu-san... You're good at this.

Really? I wouldn't have guessed that about you,
but, being more measured about it is more mature.
Really? I'm actually the same way.

To this day, I'm still not very good at dealing
with customers who don't specifically request me.

Really? Well, that's not the kind of thing
you can just get over because you want to.
Hm... I wonder what I could do then.

Think of them as vegetables.
I've heard that works.
Isn't that a trick to stop being nervous?
Oh, is it?

But, it might be a good idea to
be a little less wary of them.

How about trying to love them
from the bottom of your heart?
That seems rather grandiose...

But I s'pose I could be putting up some
internal walls. I'll keep at it!

I don't know.
I'm not good at it either.

You make a good point!
I asked the wrong person.

But you and I clicked right from the start,
so maybe we have a more natural chemistry.
Yeah, maybe.

Anyway, I'm glad we're compatible
with each other. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Wow, that's amazing.
You'll have to take me to one sometime.
Hm... About 40?
Huh... So I look a little younger than I am.

You definitely still look young, Kiryu-san.
You've aged like a fine wine.

I think you're a great guy.
You seem like you'd be a hit with the ladies.

I think you're really charming...
Yeah... And handsome...

You're... someone irreplaceable to me, I guess?
It's embarrassing saying that to your face.

I can go either way, I guess.
Age isn't a factor to me.

That said, I guess I like strong, independent men,
so I probably lean more toward older guys.

Yeah, it does seem like that's the
type of guy you'd get along with.
I... don't really have any fetishes.

If I had to say, I like open-minded people.
That's not really a fetish, though.
I really want more beauty products...
Should I give you some as a present?

No, I'll work toward buying them myself.
But in exchange, you should request me again. <symbol=note_with_outline>
Okay, sure.

My first love...
When was that again?

Probably when I was a student. There was this
cute senpai, and I had a crush on him.

But I'm actually pretty shy,
so I never confessed to him.
Do you regret it?

A little, but nothin' to be done about it now.
Just have to accept it wasn't meant to be and move on!

Maybe it'd be easier if I just learned to
confess my feelings to whoever I wanted.
Then, why not practice on me?
Maybe. I'll think about it.

Oh, so you're type who prefers that
someone confess to you?

I guess so. If I like a guy, I'll try to make
it as comfortable as I can for him to do that.
